basis: Correct QA Pilot visual implementation by using the current Librarian frontend from CarbideFrame as the read-only design reference. Remediate admin, catalog, identity, and course runtime pages using extracted Librarian primitives.
Remediate export, import, and certificate pages.
Validate all 8 pages against Librarian reference matrix. Confirm no regressions. Final report.
